intro: This server has its own Discord bot, {bot}. Link your Discord account to it and it'll DM you about what's happening here, and can copy your Discord profile over.
bot_offline: The bot is offline right now, so it can't take codes or send anything. Your settings still save.
step_add_title: Add the bot to your Discord account
step_add_body: Pick "Add to My Apps" when Discord asks. It only gets slash commands and the right to DM you.
step_add_no_link: The bot hasn't logged in to Discord yet, so there's no link to add it. Ask the server owner.
step_code_body: It works once and runs out after 10 minutes.
code_expires: Good until {time}. Getting a new one stops this one working.
step_send_body: Anywhere on Discord, type /nightcord link and paste the code. Only you see the reply, and this page updates by itself.
privacy_note: Linking tells this server your Discord username and ID, and tells Discord what you get notified about. Unlink any time.
unlink_body: {name} stops getting notifications from this server. You can link again with a new code.
dm_refused: Discord wouldn't let the bot DM you last time. Keep it added to your account and allow DMs from apps (Discord: User Settings → Content & Social), then send a test.
sync_intro: Makes your Nightcord profile match Discord. If Discord has no avatar or banner, yours is cleared too.
sync_note: Bots can't read Discord bios or pronouns, so those stay as they are. /nightcord sync does the same thing from Discord.
notify_intro: What the bot DMs you about. The same switches are in /nightcord notifications.
kind_mentions_hint: In guilds, unless you set that channel or guild to Nothing
kind_dms_hint: DMs and group DMs you haven't muted
kind_announcements_hint: New posts in your Inbox, and rule changes
only_when_away: Only while I'm not on Nightcord
only_when_away_hint: Held back while any of your devices is open and you're not away
include_content_hint: Off, a DM only says who wrote where. On, the text goes through Discord.
dnd_note: Nothing is sent while you're on Do Not Disturb.
test_sent_toast: Sent! Check your DMs on Discord.
test_refused_toast: Discord wouldn't let the bot DM you.
